name: manimgx
description: The animation engine for agents, in the browser: blazingly fast math and 3D videos with Manim's Python API, run by Pyodide in a Web Worker, on a Rust GPU core with WebGPU.

scripts.check: bun run format:check && tsc --project tsconfig.json && tsc --project tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build: bun run check && bun run build.ts && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit false --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test tests && bun run test:types

author: Academa Team <team@academa.ai>
